name: Mohammad Montasim Al Mamun Shuvo
title: Senior Software Engineer | React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript | Real-Time & AI-Driven SaaS
tagline: Building deterministic, high-performance software with scalable architecture for real-time systems and AI-driven applications.
about:
I build software around **predictable behavior**, **scalable architecture**, and performance that holds up in production.

I'm a **Senior Software Engineer** with **3+ years** of experience in real-time systems, AI integration, and multi-tenant SaaS. I work across the stack with React, Next.js, Node.js, and TypeScript, connecting user-facing experiences with the services and data behind them. After two promotions at MyMedicalHub, I now own frontend architecture across a multi-service platform, lead PR reviews, and mentor fellow engineers.

My work has reduced cloud infrastructure costs by **70%** through Azure migration and automated CI/CD, improved application performance by **40%**, and achieved **Lighthouse 90+** scores. I've built a real-time **computer vision** pipeline with MediaPipe sustaining **60 FPS** at **99.9% reliability**, and a deterministic **finite-state-machine** engine that eliminated race conditions during live AI analysis.

I pay particular attention to state transitions, asynchronous workflows, and resource lifecycles. Clear boundaries, predictable failure handling, and maintainable code guide how I design systems, integrate AI, and evolve products as their requirements grow.
